text: 英国经济创下两年半以来的最快增速，企业和消费者在伊朗战争引发的能源冲击下展现出了韧性。英国国家统计局周四公布的数据显示，第三季度GDP增长0.7%，增速较第二季度的0.5%有所加快。这一数据与机构预测中值一致。仅9月份单月，GDP就增长了0.2%，表现好于此前预期的零增长。自伊朗战争爆发以来，英国经济的表现超出了此前关于经济放缓的预测，这在一定程度上得益于与人工智能应用相关的支出。经济学家们不得不上调了对今年经济增长的预测；英国财政大臣希利周三表示，他的目标是让2027年的经济表现再次超越预期。尽管这些数据对政府而言是一大利好，但也给英国央行带来了再次加
text_en: The UK economy posted its fastest growth in two and a half years, with businesses and consumers showing resilience amid the energy shock triggered by the Iran war. Data released by the UK Office for National Statistics on Thursday showed that third-quarter GDP grew 0.7%, accelerating from 0.5% in the second quarter. The figure was in line with the median forecast of institutions. In September alone, GDP grew 0.2%, better than the previously expected zero growth. Since the outbreak of the Iran war, the UK economy has outperformed previous forecasts of a slowdown, partly thanks to spending related to AI applications. Economists have had to upgrade their forecasts for economic growth this year; UK Chancellor of the Exchequer Healey said on Wednesday that his goal is for the economy to again exceed expectations in 2027.
